title: 第二十七章 长老团的恶梦第二十八章 三代的震惊
slug: 火影之银色王座第九十四章恶魔
content_zh:
“老哥，你从小离开了木叶，可好像别人很尊敬你的样子？”鸣人好奇的问道，冥帝微微一笑“或许吧。”
波风冥帝并不知道，当年他与九尾之间的战斗，虽然他没有打败九尾，但足以让他彻底在木叶爆红！此刻卡卡西道“我们要去提交任务了，冥帝，一起去吧。”
“好。”冥帝点了点头。
冥帝离开之前，明明就已经叫三代好好照顾鸣人的，可是三代怎么照顾的？
“轰！”堂堂木叶火影办公室的大门被冥帝一脚给踹飞了！三代火影从座位上猛然站了起来“谁？”
“是我！”冥帝缓缓的走了进去。三代火影看着那一头银色，特别是诡异右眼的时候，三代火影一愣“你？你是冥帝？这么多年没见，你已经长这么大了吗？”
“我是长大了！”冥帝走了过去“但是你却老了，人老了，连心都已经老了。”
卡卡西他们看着冥帝居然敢这么对三代火影说话，而且三代火影一点都不生气，都感到了吃惊！
鸣人一脸崇拜，不愧是我老哥啊！
三代叹了口气。此时冥帝道“还有一件事情，我要和你说清楚，从今日开始，鸣人不再叫漩涡鸣人，而是波风鸣人！”
“不行！”三代一脸犹豫，而此刻走进来了几个人，为首的便是团藏，水户门炎等人一脸无奈。
“不行？”冥帝冷冷看着团藏“这是我的家事，我来说一声，只是因为礼貌而已！答应不答应，你们不能做主。”
“什么？”团藏皱起眉头，深沉道“鸣人是人柱力，我们长老团已经给他命名为漩涡鸣人了。”
“你们算什么东西！”冥帝身子一动！团藏眼眸一缩，还没有反应过来，冥帝已经一手掐住了团藏的脖子。
“你....你怎么敢？”团藏呼吸困难，艰难的道。冥帝靠近了团藏，轻声道“我知道宇智波一族的事情，你最好给我老实点！我不介意让你们长老团遗臭万年。”
团藏脸色惊愕！
接着冥帝便是将团藏甩了出去，团藏不动用他的写轮眼的话，实力根本不入冥帝眼中。
“冥帝！你真的要这么做吗？”三代道。冥帝眼神坚定的点了点头“我说过了，这是我波风家的家事。”
“我明白了。”三代火影叹了口气，答应了下来，瘫软的坐在了椅子之上。他知道他对不起水门。
他也会尸鬼封尽之术，但是面对九尾之时，他却没有上前！水门是木叶的英雄，而他身为木叶火影却让英雄之子在木叶收到了白眼，嘲讽。

团藏此刻站起来“不可以！鸣人必须叫漩涡鸣人！若是叫波风鸣人，这不就是让人知道他是波风水门的儿子？”
鸣人拳头紧握！卡卡西等人也是怒视团藏，团藏所作所为太过分了。冥帝冷冷一笑，伸出了手指“雷遁，千鸟锐枪！”便是射穿了团藏的胸膛，将团藏定在了墙壁之上“团藏，以后自然有人来杀你！今天我就告诉你，你在我眼中，不过一条狗，你最好不要太放肆！”
“波风冥帝，你做的太过分了。”水户门炎等顾问纷纷上前，说道。此时波风冥帝拿出了银制面具，微微笑道“我很过分吗？请再说一次。”
看到波风冥帝手中银制面具，水户门炎等人全部闭嘴了。银色恶魔，这几年闹的沸沸腾腾的杀神，居然会是波风冥帝？
水户门炎等人脸色惶恐，传闻之中银色恶魔想杀之人，没有一个不死的！最有名的便是铁之国大名，邀请来雷影，土影两大影保护自己！可最后那铁之国大名还是死了！
冥帝看那些人闭嘴，点了点头“这才乖！哈哈哈！”随即朝着猿飞日斩道“好了，事情就这么决定了，鸣人今日起便是叫波风鸣人！我们还是住在波风一家的房子里面。”
“可是那个房子已经.....”三代火影真的不知道该怎么说下去了，那个房子已经让水户门炎给住进去了，如今鸣人住的那根本是木叶的救济房！三代不由怨恨的看了一眼水户门炎！
波风冥帝注意到了三代的目光，也是看向了水户门炎。
“对不起，都是我不对！”水户门炎慌忙的道歉“我不该让鸣人去住救济房，我不该搬进去你们波风家的。”
“混蛋！”冥帝一脚踹去，便是将水户门炎直接一脚朝着窗户外踢了下去，哼道“这是长老？还是强盗？”
三代火影脸色尴尬！
而团藏等人更是不由得低下了头去，他们没想到波风冥帝回来了，而且如此强势归来。
“好了，我和鸣人先走了。”说完话之后，冥帝便是带着鸣人离开。没有人敢阻拦他！
“这个.....”卡卡西尴尬了，不知道该说什么好。三代皱着眉头“卡卡西，你们也回去吧。”
“是！”卡卡西点了点头，便是和佐助等人出去了。一路上，佐助，小樱，卡卡西都心不在焉，没想到一下子，事情发生了这么大的变化！
更让他们震撼的是波风冥帝的实力，直接打的叫长老团他们哑口无言！这也更加证明了，这个忍者世界，实力才是最大的道理。
。。。。。。波风冥帝先是和鸣人一起回到了鸣人原来住的家，收拾东西。看着那房间，还有那过去的牛奶什么的，波风冥帝不由得皱起来了眉头！“鸣人，你吃的都是这些吗？”
“是啊”鸣人点了点头“不过，我还是觉得一乐拉面最好吃了。”
想起一乐拉面那味道，冥帝又是皱了皱眉头“好了，快点收拾，我们立即走人。”
“恩。”鸣人点了点头，收拾了一会，终于收拾好了一些比他本人还要高大的包袱，背在了后背上，咬着牙便是背了起来。

冥帝无语“还是我来吧。”
冥帝伸出左手，拿着提起来了那个包袱，鸣人看冥帝一点不费力的样子，傻了眼“老哥，你看起来和我一样瘦，为什么？力气这么大？”
“我力气大？”冥帝摇了摇头“你不知道，其实我力气很小！”

content_en:
"Brother, you left Konoha when you were young, but you seem to be respected by others?" Naruto asked curiously, and Hades smiled slightly, "Maybe."
Namikaze Hades didn't know that in the battle between him and Kyuubi, although he didn't defeat Kyuubi, it was enough to make him famous in Konoha! At this moment, Kakashi said, "We are going to submit the task. Emperor Hades, let's go together."
"Okay." Underworld Emperor nodded.
Before Hades left, he had clearly asked the Third Generation to take good care of Naruto, but how did the Third Generation take care of him?
"Boom!" The door to the dignified Konoha Hokage's office was kicked away by Hades! The Third Hokage suddenly stood up from his seat, "Who?"
"It's me!" Emperor Hades walked in slowly. When the Third Hokage looked at that silver head, especially the weird right eye, the Third Hokage was stunned, "You? Are you the Hades Emperor? I haven't seen you for so many years, have you grown so big?"
"I have grown up!" Emperor Hades walked over, "But you are old. You are old, and even your heart is old."
Kakashi and the others were surprised when they saw that Hades dared to speak to the Third Hokage like this, and the Third Hokage was not angry at all!
Naruto looked adoring, he is indeed my brother!
The third generation sighed. At this time, Emperor Hades said, "There is one more thing. I want to make it clear to you. From today on, Naruto will no longer be called Uzumaki Naruto, but Namikaze Naruto!"
"No!" The third generation looked hesitant, but at this moment several people walked in, headed by Danzo, and Mito Kadoen and others looked helpless.
"No?" Emperor Hades looked at Danzo coldly. "This is my family matter. I'm just saying it out of politeness! You can't decide whether to agree or not."
"What?" Danzo frowned and said deeply, "Naruto is a Jinchuuriki, and our group of elders has named him Uzumaki Naruto."
"Who do you think you are!" Emperor Hades moved! Danzo's eyes narrowed, and before he could react, Hades had already grabbed Danzo's neck with one hand.
"You...how dare you?" Danzo said with difficulty, breathing hard. Emperor Hades approached Danzo and said softly, "I know what happened to the Uchiha clan. You'd better be honest with me! I don't mind letting your group of elders be infamy for eternity."
Danzo looked shocked!
Then Emperor Hades threw Danzo out. If Danzo didn't use his Sharingan, his strength would not be in the eyes of Emperor Hades.
"Underworld Emperor! Do you really want to do this?" Sandai said. Emperor Hades nodded with firm eyes, "I told you, this is a family matter of my Namikaze family."
"I understand." The Third Hokage sighed, agreed, and sat slumped on the chair. He knew he was sorry for Minato.
He also knew how to seal away corpses, but when faced with the Nine-Tails, he didn't step forward! Minato is the hero of Konoha, but as the Hokage of Konoha, the son of a hero received a blank stare and ridicule in Konoha.
Danzo stood up at this moment, "No! Naruto must be called Uzumaki Naruto! If he is called Namikaze Naruto, wouldn't this mean that people know that he is Namikaze Minato's son?"
Naruto clenched his fists! Kakashi and others also glared at Danzo, saying that what Danzo had done was too much. Emperor Hades smiled coldly, stretched out his finger, "Thunder Release, Thousand Birds Sharp Spear!" and shot Danzo through the chest, fixing Danzo on the wall. "Duanzo, someone will naturally come to kill you in the future! I will tell you today, you are nothing more than a dog in my eyes, you'd better not be too presumptuous!"
"Namikaze Hades, you have gone too far." Mito Kadoen and other advisors stepped forward and said. At this time, Emperor Namikaze took out the silver mask, smiled slightly and said, "Am I going too far? Please say it again."
Seeing the silver mask in Namikaze Hade's hand, Mito Kadoyan and others all shut up. The silver demon, the murderous god who has caused so much trouble in recent years, is actually Namikaze Hades?
Mito Kadoyan and others looked horrified. According to rumors, there was no one the Silver Demon wanted to kill.Immortal! The most famous one is the Daimyo of the Kingdom of Iron, who invited the two great shadows of Raikage and Tsuchikage to protect him! But in the end, the great name of the Kingdom of Iron died!
Emperor Hades saw those people shut up and nodded, "That's good! Hahaha!" Then he said to Hiruzen Sarutobi, "Okay, the matter has been decided. From today on, Naruto will be called Naruto Namikaze! We still live in the house of the Namikaze family."
"But that house has..." The Third Hokage really didn't know what to say anymore. Mito Kadoyan has already moved into that house, and now the place where Naruto lives is basically a relief house in Konoha! The third generation couldn't help but glance at Mito Kadoyan with resentment!
Namikaze Hades noticed the third generation's gaze and also looked at Mito Monobu.
"I'm sorry, it's all my fault!" Mito Kadoren apologized hurriedly, "I shouldn't have let Naruto live in the soup kitchen. I shouldn't have moved into your Namikaze family."
"Bastard!" Emperor Ming kicked Mito Menyan directly out of the window and hummed, "Is this an elder? Or a robber?"
The Third Hokage looked embarrassed!
Danzo and others couldn't help but lower their heads. They didn't expect Namikaze Hades to come back and come back so powerfully.
"Okay, Naruto and I are leaving first." After speaking, Hades took Naruto away. No one dares to stop him!
"This..." Kakashi was embarrassed and didn't know what to say. The third generation frowned and said, "Kakashi, you should go back too."
"Yes!" Kakashi nodded and went out with Sasuke and others. Along the way, Sasuke, Sakura, and Kakashi were all distracted. Unexpectedly, things had changed so much all of a sudden!
What shocked them even more was the strength of Emperor Namikaze, who directly beat the group of elders and made them speechless! This further proves that in this ninja world, strength is the most important thing.
. . . . . . Namikaze Hades first returned to Naruto's original home with Naruto and packed his things. Looking at the room and the milk and other things in the past, Emperor Namikaze couldn't help but frowned! "Naruto, is this all you eat?"
"Yeah" Naruto nodded, "But I still think Ichiraku Ramen is the best."
Thinking of the smell of Ichiraku Ramen, Hades frowned again, "Okay, hurry up and pack up, we'll leave immediately."
"Yes." Naruto nodded, and after packing for a while, he finally packed some baggage that was taller than himself, put it on his back, and carried it with gritted teeth.
Emperor Hades was speechless, "I'll do it."
Underworld Emperor stretched out his left hand and lifted the bundle. Naruto was dumbfounded when he saw how effortlessly Underworld Emperor looked, "Brother, you look as thin as me. Why? Are you so strong?"
"Am I strong?" Emperor Hades shook his head, "You don't know, I am actually very weak!"
